causality.method: independent direct sums over strictly earlier dates
independent brute-force recomputation over time_ms < target_time_ms
causality.synthetic_same_timestamp_stress_test: passed; tied rows saw no values from one another and the later row saw their mean

feature_definitions.hist_watch_decay_mean_2.5: timestamp-decayed mean clipped watch fraction, user history, 2.5-day half-life
feature_definitions.hist_watch_decay_mean_5: timestamp-decayed mean clipped watch fraction, user history, 5-day half-life
feature_definitions.hist_watch_last5_mean: mean defined clipped fractions among the five strictly-prior interactions; invalid-duration rows occupy window positions but do not enter the mean
feature_definitions.hist_watch_tab_decay_mean_3: timestamp-decayed mean clipped watch fraction for matching user/tab history, 3-day half-life

base_feature_metadata.ordering: per user by time_ms; all exact time_ms ties read before group update; orig_idx orders tied rows only for future last-five windows

policy.clipping: clip to [0, 1] because completion saturates at 1 and the raw upper tail reaches 68.31
policy.current_row_play_time: never read into its own feature; update occurs only after feature snapshot
policy.duration_ms_equal_0: undefined; row stays in interaction ordering but does not update watch-value numerator/denominator

feature_definitions.meta_music_id: static music_id, native high-cardinality categorical; tested separately
feature_definitions.meta_tag: static full tag string, native categorical
feature_definitions.video_age_days: interaction date minus upload date in whole days, computed per impression

leakage_policy.categorical_vocabularies: train-only; unseen future levels map to NaN
leakage_policy.upload_age: row interaction_date minus static upload_dt; no negative ages

selection_policy.test_access: none until branch, weights, confirmation, diagnostics, and verdict are frozen

test_evaluation.timing: after validation selection, confirmation, diagnostics, and verdict freeze
